- league_stats_get_top_scorer: fetch the top scorer of a specified football league. We can use it to get the top scorer of the Premier League in the 2019-2020 season. Provide league_name: "Premier League", season: "2019-2020".

2. team_stats_get_top_scorer for Manchester United in Premier League.
3. league_stats_get_top_scorer for Premier League in 2019-2020.
